hero.title: Computer Association
hero.subtitle: Serving students, promoting campus computer culture
hero.description: Founded on May 31, 2008, GDUECA Computer Association is an academic and technology club on the Huadu Campus. We are known for weekly hands-on sessions, free repair clinics, anti-fraud cybersecurity competitions, and esports events.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: By accessing or using this website, you agree to the following terms

items.title: Acceptance of Terms
items.content: By accessing or using this website, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, please stop using the site.

items.title: Lawful Use
items.content: Users must not use this website for any illegal, malicious, harmful, or unauthorized purpose, including but not limited to attacks, scraping forms, or harassment.

items.title: Content License
items.content: Content you submit (bug reports, registration info) is licensed to the club for activity management and site optimization. It will not be publicly disclosed without your consent.

items.title: Prohibited Conduct
items.content: Unauthorized bulk scraping of site content or malicious form submissions to block others is prohibited. Violators may have their access revoked.

items.title: Changes to Terms
items.content: The club may modify site content, suspend or terminate service, or revise these terms at any time. Changes will be posted on the website.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We value your privacy. Here's how we collect, use, and protect your information

items.title: Information We Collect
items.content: When you submit an activity registration, we collect your name, college, major, student ID, phone number, and email. Bug reports collect the contact information you provide. We also automatically record the source IP address (private, public, or IPv6) at submission time, solely for security auditing and abuse prevention; it is never made public.

items.title: How We Use It
items.content: Used solely for registration review, activity notifications, bug follow-up, and site maintenance. We do not sell or rent your information to third parties.

items.title: Data Storage
items.content: Data is stored on club-managed servers, accessible only to club administrators. After an activity ends, data is retained or purged according to club rules.

items.title: Your Rights
items.content: You may contact club administrators to request access to or deletion of your submitted records.

items.title: Security
items.content: We use password-protected access and IP blacklists to protect data, but cannot guarantee absolute security.

items.title: Cookies
items.content: This site may use essential cookies to maintain login sessions. No tracking cookies are used.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.subtitle: This is a non-official, non-profit student club website. Content is for reference only

items.title: Non-Official Statement
items.content: This website is a non-official, non-profit public-interest site maintained by the GDUE Computer Association student club. All content is for learning and communication only and does not constitute professional advice.

items.title: Content Accuracy
items.content: Activity information, tutorials, and materials published here are for reference only. The club reserves the right to correct any errors.

items.title: User Responsibility
items.content: Users are responsible for the accuracy of the information they submit. Consequences of providing false information are borne by the user.

items.title: Service Availability
items.content: We take reasonable measures to protect data security, but do not guarantee the site is fault-free or vulnerability-free. The club is not liable for indirect losses arising from access to or use of this website.

items.title: External Links
items.content: Links to external websites are not under the club's control, and we are not responsible for their content.

items.title: Objections
items.content: If you object to this disclaimer, please stop using this website.
